snippet.title: Random Mix: a new song every play | Early Access trailer
snippet.description:
Random Mix writes a new song every time you press play, then lets you play it, reshape it and keep it.

Out now in Early Access on Steam, Google Play and the App Store. 

Free demo in your browser at https://randommix.app

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5042870/Random_Mix/
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.randommix
App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6801342446

Every song in this video is synthesized live on the device by a procedural audio engine. There are no music files and no connection to any AI service: the game works fully offline.

Random Mix is in Early Access. The visuals, interface, audio engine, and song generator will improve throughout development.

*As a casual rhythm game:* press play, tap the notes, get a song nobody has heard before, shuffle it into another one.

*As a studio:* six stems (drums, bass, chords, top, hook, pad), a 16-step beat editor, a note roll, tweak knobs for every part, mashups of three genres, and an export studio that trims a section and saves it as WAV, MP3 or OGG. Anything you export is yours to use in any project, no attribution needed.

Five play modes, five arcade modes, 50+ genres, and a share code for every song so the same song plays on any device.
